UFC 330: Makhachev vs. Machado Garry
PromotionUltimate Fighting Championship
DateNovember 15, 2026 (2026-11-15)
VenueMadison Square Garden

UFC 330: Makhachev vs. Machado Garry is an upcoming mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that will take place on November 15, 2026.

Background

[edit]

A UFC Lightweight Championship bout between current champion Islam Makhachev and Ian Machado Garry is expected to headline the event.[2]

Lightweight bout: Prosa Uno vs. Prosa Dos was rumored, but never booked.
